items.title: Ukraine allies in Poland after Starlink sabotage, Trump diesel deal
items.summary: Germany's Johann Wadephul said hybrid plots like the Starlink fire showed Europe was "in Russia's crosshairs." The UK's Ed Miliband said Trump's Russian diesel deal led to a "very difficult few days" diplomatically.

items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".
items.why_relevant: MI5 警告 AI 威胁，安全与科技交叉

confirmed_facts.text: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI - Published MI5 is devoting more resource to countering state threats than during the Cold War, the head of the intelligence service has said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI - Published MI5 is devoting more resource to countering state threats than during the Cold War, the head of the intelligence service has said.

confirmed_facts.text: Sir Ken McCallum said threats from foreign adversaries had quadrupled in the last decade, with Russia "aggressor number one" as well as increased Iran-linked aggression against Jewish sites and military bases.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Sir Ken McCallum said threats from foreign adversaries had quadrupled in the last decade, with Russia "aggressor number one" as well as increased Iran-linked aggression against Jewish sites and military bases.

confirmed_facts.text: At an annual speech in London, MI5's chief said Russia was waging hybrid warfare at a time when AI was "supercharging the cyber-security contest between attackers and defenders".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: At an annual speech in London, MI5's chief said Russia was waging hybrid warfare at a time when AI was "supercharging the cyber-security contest between attackers and defenders".

confirmed_facts.text: He also warned of rising threats from "extreme right-wing terrorism" and said MI5 had "caught terrorists seeking to exploit AI," including by integrating the technology with drones.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: He also warned of rising threats from "extreme right-wing terrorism" and said MI5 had "caught terrorists seeking to exploit AI," including by integrating the technology with drones.

confirmed_facts.text: He said the biggest threat from the misuse of AI was extremist groups using the technology to harness new and existing bioweapons.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: He said the biggest threat from the misuse of AI was extremist groups using the technology to harness new and existing bioweapons.

confirmed_facts.text: Sir Ken said Russia had stopped short of "conventional conflict" against Nato and is instead trying to unsettle European countries while its progress in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine is "minimal and horrifically costly".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Sir Ken said Russia had stopped short of "conventional conflict" against Nato and is instead trying to unsettle European countries while its progress in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine is "minimal and horrifically costly".

items.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
items.summary: Four years after the attacks, Serhii K will appear in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.
items.why_relevant: 北溪事件开审，关键地缘政治进展

confirmed_facts.text: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines - Published Four years after one of the most dramatic acts of sabotage in modern European history, a Ukrainian man goes on trial in Hamburg on Wednesday accused of blowing up Russia's Nord Stream gas pipe
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines - Published Four years after one of the most dramatic acts of sabotage in modern European history, a Ukrainian man goes on trial in Hamburg on Wednesday accused of blowing up Russia's Nord Stream gas pipe

confirmed_facts.text: Serhii K, as he is identified by German prosecutors, is accused of plotting with other Ukrainian military personnel to destroy the pipelines and stop Russia financing its war with gas revenue.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Serhii K, as he is identified by German prosecutors, is accused of plotting with other Ukrainian military personnel to destroy the pipelines and stop Russia financing its war with gas revenue.

confirmed_facts.text: The case is highly sensitive in Germany, seen as one of Ukraine's closest allies since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, seven months before the attacks took place.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The case is highly sensitive in Germany, seen as one of Ukraine's closest allies since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, seven months before the attacks took place.

confirmed_facts.text: Serhii K, extradited to Germany last year, will become the first suspect to go on trial for the blasts.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Serhii K, extradited to Germany last year, will become the first suspect to go on trial for the blasts.

confirmed_facts.text: He denies the charges, as does a second suspect who is fighting extradition from Croatia.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: He denies the charges, as does a second suspect who is fighting extradition from Croatia.

confirmed_facts.text: In the months after explosives destroyed three of the four gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea off the island of Bornholm on 26 September 2022, Western suspicion looked towards Moscow without directly apportioning blame.

items.title: lyogavin/airllm
items.summary:
AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU 
Quickstart | Configurations | MacOS | Example notebooks | FAQ 
AirLLM dramatically reduces inference memory usage, letting 70B large language models run on a single 4GB GPU card — without quantization, distillation, or pruning. You can even run Kimi K3 (2.8T) — the largest open-source model released to date — on under 4GB, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B) on 6GB, and DeepSeek-V3 (671B) on ~12GB. We now also support training huge models on small VRAM: Qwen3
